leitura.texto: Marta Silva was born in 1979 in a small town in Paraná. She grew up with her grandparents because her parents worked in another city. When she was a child, she loved drawing machines. She finished school in 1996 and got her first job at a furniture factory. She worked there for six years and learned a lot about production. In 2003, she decided to study mechanical engineering at night. It was a difficult time: she worked all day and studied at night. She met her husband, Caio, at the university. They got married in 2009 and had a daughter two years later. In 2015, a German company hired Marta, and in 2021 she became the plant manager. She is very proud of her story.

perguntas.enunciado: Who did she grow up with?
What did she love when she was a child?
How long did she work there?

opcoes: She worked all day and studied at night.

perguntas.enunciado: When did she have a daughter?

falas.en: Welcome to the show, Mr. Costa. Tell us about your company. How did it begin?
falas.pt: Bem-vindo ao programa, Sr. Costa. Fale da sua empresa. Como ela começou?

falas.en: I started it in my garage in 1998. I had only one machine.
falas.pt: Comecei na minha garagem em 1998. Eu tinha só uma máquina.

falas.en: Only one? What did you make?
falas.pt: Só uma? O que você fazia?

falas.en: Small metal parts for bicycles. My wife did the accounts.
falas.pt: Pequenas peças de metal para bicicletas. Minha esposa cuidava das contas.

falas.en: When did you move to a real factory?
falas.pt: Quando vocês foram para uma fábrica de verdade?

falas.en: In 2004. We bought an old building and hired ten people.
falas.pt: Em 2004. Compramos um prédio antigo e contratamos dez pessoas.

falas.en: Today we have two hundred employees. I didn't imagine that!
falas.pt: Hoje temos duzentos funcionários. Eu não imaginava isso!

perguntas.enunciado: Where did Mr. Costa start his company?
How many people did they hire in 2004?
How many employees do they have today?

escrita.instrucao_pt: Conte a história da sua vida em ordem (nascimento, infância, estudos, trabalho, família), com datas.
Escreva sobre o seu primeiro emprego: onde foi, quanto tempo ficou, o que aprendeu e por que saiu.

fala.pergunta_en: Where were you born, and where did you grow up?
fala.instrucao_pt: Responda em voz alta com was born e grew up, e fale um pouco da sua infância.

fala.pergunta_en: Tell me about an important year in your life. What happened?
fala.instrucao_pt: Fale em voz alta sobre um ano importante e o que aconteceu (use o passado).

foco_avaliacao: Nível A2. Passado simples com verbos irregulares (went, had, ate, saw, came, got, made, took, bought, began, left, became, met, grew up), was born, did/didn't em perguntas e negativas, datas e duração (in 2010, for five years), contar a história de vida.
